description: This file is a shell script containing tests for the colorization of remote messages in a Git environment. It defines various test cases for verifying that colored output appears correctly based on different configurations and message contents.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up test environment or state for testing Git hooks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of commands.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes colorized output into a readable format for verification.
